item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 12/May/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will linger over the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. There will be heavy showers and squally thunderstorms over the region. A surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of Guangdong on Sunday. It will be windy with temperatures falling progressively over the region. With the trough of low pressure departing the coastal areas, the weather will improve gradually early to midweek next week. With the monsoon moderating, temperatures over the coast of Guangdong will rise in the latter part of next week.
